On Saturday alone, Benge belted a 370-foot home run, collected a broken-bat bloop single and added his swinging bunt one inning later.

recapNotes: Orion Kerkering sat in front of his locker inside a mostly empty visitors’ clubhouse late Friday night at Citi Field.
He had started the sixth inning of a one-run game against the Mets, but five batters later, he surrendered a three-run home run to Juan Soto to send the Phillies to a 6-3 loss .

recapNotes: It’s been quite easy to get caught up in the results of Nolan McLean ’s rookie season, to become enamored with the electric stuff leaving his hand as he reached double-digit wins with a seven-inning gem in his previous outing vs.

But according to interim manager Andy Green, the massive strides McLean has made in 2026 -- which showed up in a start where he only notched four strikeouts -- are impressive in a slightly different light.

lastMeeting.recapHeadline: Mets get knocked down, then get up again to grind out series win
recapNotes: After the Mets secured their first road series win of the season with a 5-2 comeback victory over the Giants on Sunday, Chumbawamba’s earworm of a 1997 hit, “Tubthumping,” blasted through a mostly empty Oracle Park.

This afternoon, it was a fitting coda for a game (and series) that saw the visiting Mets -- already a bit banged-up and not at full strength -- get knocked down, only to get up again off the deck and secure a happy flight back home to Queens.

lastMeeting.summary: On 2026-08-31, the Mets beat the Tampa Bay Rays 3-2 at Tropicana Field.
lastMeeting.recapHeadline: Vientos returns with a bang to back career-best outing from Stock
recapNotes: Mets manager Andy Green said prior to Monday’s series opener against the Rays that after seeing Mark Vientos crush three homers at Triple-A on Sunday , “I think the smart thing is to get him in the lineup as quickly as possible and see if he can do that again here.” Vientos didn’t have another homer hat trick in him, but he slugged a solo shot to one of the deepest parts of Tropicana Field in the Mets’ 3-2 victory over the team with the best record (82-55) in the American League.
Vientos was activated from the injured list Monday after missing about seven weeks with a fractured right hand.

lastMeeting.recapHeadline: An IL return. An injury scare. A go-ahead RBI. All in a day's work for Soto
recapNotes: For the briefest of moments, his leg coursing in pain, Juan Soto said that “everything went through my mind.” Hopping around, trying to shake off the discomfort after fouling a ball off his leg just above his right shin guard, Soto could hardly believe his luck: two hours clear of the injured list and already hurt again.
Then Soto indeed shook it off, stepped back to the plate and ripped a 100.4 mph RBI single to right.

lastMeeting.recapHeadline: Vintage Brown (10 K's) could provide huge boost in Astros' title chase
recapNotes: The return of right-hander Hunter Brown to ace form on Friday night could be as big of a development in recent weeks for the Astros as any other in their push to win the American League West, especially if he’s able to keep it up in the final month of the regular season.

Brown, winless in his previous four starts in August, delivered one of his best outings of the season by striking out 10 batters and allowing one run in 6 2/3 innings to lead the Astros to a 3-1 win over the Mets at Citi Field.

recapNotes: MILWAUKEE – The Brewers have the best record in franchise history to this point in a season and the second-biggest division lead in Major League Baseball, which stood at 6 1/2 games over the Cubs with 60 regular-season games to go after Wednesday’s 4-3 win over the Mets at American Family Field.

Given that success on the field, Brewers officials are prepared to adopt a more aggressive approach at the Trade Deadline compared to recent years, according to sources familiar with the club’s thinking.
